products.name: Soundraw
products.note: Royalty-free AI music; commercial license; JASRAC considerations for Japan use

profile_text.body:
Soundraw is an AI music generator founded in 2020 and headquartered in Shibuya, Tokyo. The company describes itself as built by musicians to make music creation easy and accessible, and its platform allows users to generate royalty-free beats and tracks by selecting genres, moods, and instrument settings without requiring musical theory knowledge or a digital audio workstation. Users can blend genres, edit arrangements at the bar level, and export tracks as high-quality WAV files or separate stems.

The company's stated legal position centers on its training data: Soundraw says its AI is trained exclusively on music written and recorded by its own in-house producers, with the company owning the master recordings and publishing rights to that catalog. It describes this approach as distinct from tools that scrape existing songs from the internet, and it offers users a worldwide, perpetual commercial license for every generated track, with the company stating users keep 100 percent of royalties. Subscription tiers include an Artist Unlimited plan that provides WAV and stem downloads alongside unlimited generation. Soundraw also notes that Japanese users should be aware of JASRAC considerations when using the service.

Soundraw describes itself as a supporter of the aiformusic initiative, which it characterizes as centered on the responsible use of AI in music, and notes that Roland and UMG are fellow supporters of that initiative. The held facts confirm Soundraw has an active profile on theworldofai.org, with no recorded litigation or MCP server presence.
